breakdown.title: The Cats in Every Garden
breakdown.logline: Tiny as a mouse, the dreamer is carried gently by Biscuit the cat from the tall grass to the warm roof, where cats in every garden sit very still, watching over them.

m6.text: The shot is a first-person view, seen through a wide 24mm lens at eye level, looking straight ahead toward the roof edge. In the middle distance, the roof edge runs across the picture near the bottom third, with the warm roof tiles sloping away beyond it. In the background, beyond the roof edge, the street gardens stretch out, and in each garden a cat sits very still, far off and small, all facing back toward the camera. The light comes from the open sky above, falling evenly on the roof tiles and the gardens. Just behind the camera, outside the picture, Biscuit stands close by.
m6.view: The camera is the dreamer's eyes, looking straight ahead: it looks toward the edge overlooking the street. A wide lens, about 24mm. Outside the picture, behind the camera: Biscuit. At the back of the picture: the edge overlooking the street. Beyond it all, ahead where they look: the gardens with cats in each one: the cats in the gardens, far off.

m7.text: Seen from the side, at the height of their eyes, about 3 metres off, with a 35mm lens. In the foreground, the roof tiles stretch from the bottom edge up to the two figures. Biscuit is across the picture from the left third to right of the middle, in profile looking right, seen from the knees up and filling the picture from low down to its bottom edge. The dreamer is right of the middle, in profile looking left, seen whole and filling the picture from a third of the way down to near its bottom. In the background, the roof tiles continue to the far side of the roof, away from the edge overlooking the street. Light comes from the open sky behind the camera, just outside the picture, where the roof edge overlooks the street.
m7.view: Seen from the side, as they face each other, about 3 metres off, at the height of their eyes: the camera looks at Biscuit, toward the far side of the place, away from the edge overlooking the street. Nobody else is in the picture. They keep these places in every picture of this scene. Outside the picture, behind the camera: the edge overlooking the street.

m8.text: The shot is a 50mm lens at Biscuit's eye height, looking straight at her from about two metres away. In the lower two-thirds of the frame, Biscuit faces the camera, centered left to right; she is a ginger cat with one white ear, lying on the warm roof tiles, her whole body visible and in sharp focus. Above her head, the top third of the picture shows the far side of the roof, away from the street edge. The foreground at the very bottom edge is the roof tiles just in front of the camera. Daylight from the sky falls across Biscuit and the tiles. Behind the camera and out of frame is the roof's edge overlooking the street.
